name: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 / Intermediate with MPC (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) and rank in AP EAPCET / JEE Mains.
description: Comprehensive program covering Data Structures, Algorithms, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, AI, Cloud Computing, and Full Stack Web Development.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Engineering Physics, Calculus, Python Programming, Digital Logic
Semester 3-4: Data Structures & OOP in Java, Computer Organization, DBMS, Discrete Math
Semester 5-6: Design & Analysis of Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Software Engineering
Semester 7-8: AI & Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Major Capstone Industry Project & Internship

name: B.Tech in CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
eligibility: 10+2 / Intermediate with MPC and qualifying rank in AP EAPCET / JEE Mains.
description: Specialized curriculum focusing on Artificial Intelligence algorithms, Deep Learning neural networks, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and Reinforcement Learning.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Foundations of AI, Linear Algebra, Python for AI, Probability & Statistics
Semester 3-4: Machine Learning Fundamentals, Neural Networks, Advanced Data Structures, Big Data Tools
Semester 5-6: Deep Learning architectures, Computer Vision with OpenCV, NLP & Transformer Models
Semester 7-8: Generative AI & LLMs, Robotics, AI Ethics, Industry Capstone Project

name: B.Tech in CSE (Data Science)
eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics & Chemistry with AP EAPCET rank.
description: Rigorous training in Statistical Inference, Big Data Analytics, Predictive Analytics, Tableau/PowerBI, and Data Engineering pipelines.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Statistical Computing, Python & R Programming, Exploratory Data Analysis
Semester 3-4: Applied Statistics, Big Data Ecosystem (Hadoop & Spark), Data Wrangling
Semester 5-6: Predictive Analytics, Data Mining, Cloud Data Warehousing (Snowflake/BigQuery)
Semester 7-8: Advanced Analytics Studio, Industry Internship, Capstone Dissertation

name: B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 / Intermediate with MPC and rank in AP EAPCET / JEE Mains.
description: Covers Electronic Devices & Circuits, VLSI Design, Embedded Systems, Digital Signal Processing, IoT, and 5G Wireless Communications.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Basic Electrical & Electronics, Circuit Theory, C Programming, Engineering Chemistry
Semester 3-4: Electronic Devices, Analog Circuits, Digital IC Design, Signals & Systems
Semester 5-6: Microprocessors & Microcontrollers, VLSI Design (Verilog/VHDL), DSP, Antennas
Semester 7-8: Wireless & 5G Communications, IoT Systems, Optical Fiber Networks, Project Work

name: B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 with MPC and rank in AP EAPCET / ECET for Lateral Entry.
description: Studies Electrical Machines, Power Transmission & Distribution, Power Electronics, Renewable Green Energy, and Electric Vehicles.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering, Engineering Graphics, Applied Physics
Semester 3-4: AC/DC Machines, Electromagnetic Fields, Power Electronics, Linear Control Systems
Semester 5-6: Power System Analysis, Switchgear & Protection, PLC & SCADA Automation
Semester 7-8: Electric Vehicle Technology, Smart Grid, Renewable Energy Systems, Final Project

name: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 with MPC and rank in AP EAPCET / ECET for Lateral Entry.
description: Covers Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, CAD/CAM/CAE, Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing), Robotics, and Automotive Systems.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Engineering Mechanics, Workshop Practice, Material Science
Semester 3-4: Thermodynamics, Mechanics of Solids, Kinematics of Machinery, Fluid Mechanics
Semester 5-6: Heat Transfer, Design of Machine Elements, CAD/CAM, Automobile Engineering
Semester 7-8: Robotics & Automation, Operations Research, CNC Machining, Industrial Internship

name: B.Tech in Civil Engineering
eligibility: 10+2 with MPC and rank in AP EAPCET / ECET for Lateral Entry.
description: Covers Structural Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Water Quality, Highway Engineering, and Total Station Surveying.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Engineering Drawing, Surveying Basics, Strength of Materials
Semester 3-4: Structural Analysis, Fluid Mechanics, Geotechnical Engineering, Concrete Technology
Semester 5-6: Design of Reinforced Concrete Structures, Steel Structures, Environmental Engineering
Semester 7-8: Transportation Engineering, Estimation & Costing, GIS & Remote Sensing, Project

name: M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering
eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in CSE/IT or equivalent with rank in AP PGCET / GATE.
description: Advanced postgraduate curriculum in distributed computing, cloud architecture, deep learning algorithms, cryptographic protocols, and independent research thesis.
curriculumHighlights: Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms, High Performance Computing
Distributed Cloud Computing, Deep Neural Networks, Advanced Cryptography
Research Methodology & IPR, Comprehensive Viva-Voce
One Full Year Industrial Project Work & Research Dissertation

name: M.Tech in VLSI & Embedded Systems
eligibility: B.E./B.Tech in ECE/EEE/EIE with rank in AP PGCET / GATE.
description: In-depth training in ASIC/FPGA design, analog & mixed-signal IC design, ARM SoC architectures, and real-time embedded systems.
curriculumHighlights: CMOS Analog IC Design, Digital VLSI Design with Cadence Tools
Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS), System-on-Chip (SoC) Design
Low Power VLSI, Hardware-Software Co-Design, Research Seminar
Full Year Industry Dissertation / Lab Research

name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
eligibility: Any recognized Bachelor's Degree with minimum 50% marks and rank in AP ICET.
description: Dual specialization in Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, and Business Analytics with corporate live projects and executive leadership bootcamps.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Management & Organizational Behavior, Managerial Economics, Financial Accounting, Business Statistics, Marketing Management
Semester 3-4: Dual Specialization Electives (Finance/Marketing/HR/Analytics), Strategic Management, Corporate Internship & Project Report

name: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
eligibility: BCA / B.Sc / B.Com / B.A with Mathematics at 10+2 or Degree level and rank in AP ICET.
description: Postgraduate professional course in enterprise Java, Python, cloud computing, modern React/Node full stack frameworks, database engineering, and software testing.
curriculumHighlights: Semester 1-2: Advanced Java, Python & Web Technologies, Operating Systems, DBMS & NoSQL, Software Engineering
Semester 3-4: Cloud Computing, Full Stack React/Node Development, Information Security, Major Industrial Project
